subject: Vendor paperwork & commercial path for TwinLeaf POC
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@twinleaf.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor paperwork & commercial path for TwinLeaf POC

Hi Elena & team,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — appreciated the clarity on the POC scope and success metrics. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so procurement has what it needs to move forward: 

Call highlights (brief):
- POC: 3-month pilot (up to 250k generated tokens/month) to validate latency and cost profile.
- Data: no PHI; all test data is synthetic for the pilot.
- Success metric: average p95 latency < 350ms for 8k prompt size.

Procurement questions we need to confirm from your side:
1) Commercial path: will TwinLeaf purchase via PO (standard for your procurements) or corporate card for initial POC?
2) Vendor setup: we can send a Redwood vendor packet (PDF) + W-9. Is there a procurement portal or vendor portal we should submit into? If so, please share the link and required fields (DUNS, remit address, ACH vs wire).
3) Tax residency: are you a US entity (W-9) or foreign (W-8)?
4) Payment terms: do you require net-30, net-45, or something else for POCs?

Attachments included: redwood-vendor-packet-v1.pdf (vendor packet, includes sample MSA + vendor setup form), redwood-w9.pdf (company W-9).

Proposed next steps (we can adjust):
- Elena: confirm PO vs card and share portal link + required vendor fields (DUNS, remit, bank details) — by end of week if possible.
- Redwood (me): return completed vendor packet and any additional finance items once you confirm required format.
- Markus (cc): will lead supplier onboarding and respond with any finance-specific asks (remit address format, invoice header).

If marketplace is of interest (AWS Marketplace), flag that now — we can discuss trade-offs (short-term convenience vs longer onboarding for a formal marketplace listing).

Thanks — I’ll follow up after we hear back and coordinate an internal checklist for finance/legal.

Best,
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-vendor-packet-v1.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-w9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@twinleaf.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendoza <carlos.mendoza@twinleaf.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor paperwork & commercial path for TwinLeaf POC

Hi Dev — thanks for the summary and the packet. Quick answers from procurement below: 

1) Commercial path: We prefer to onboard vendors via PO for traceability. For a short POC we can do a PO that references the POC statement of work.
2) Portal: Yes — we have a vendor portal. Please upload the vendor packet and bank information there. Link: https://vendor.twinleaf.com/onboard/ABCD-1234 (see instructions). The portal requires DUNS, legal entity name, remit address, and ACH details (routing/account).
3) Tax form: TwinLeaf is a US entity; we will need Redwood’s W-9 (not W-8).
4) Payment terms: Standard is net-45 but procurement is willing to consider net-30 for strategic pilots. Supplier setup typically takes ~7-10 business days after we receive a completed packet and the W-9.

Attachments we need from you once portal is open: completed vendor packet (PDF), company W-9, completed bank info form (we can send a portal template if you prefer).

Also copying Carlos (IT security) on the thread — he may request an evidence pack (SOC2 report) later, but for vendor setup the items above are the immediate gating items.

Thanks,
Elena Rojas
Procurement Manager | TwinLeaf Technologies
elena.rojas@twinleaf.com

--
Elena Rojas wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning. We'll prioritize the packet once you confirm we should expect the upload to the portal link above.

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@twinleaf.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor paperwork & commercial path for TwinLeaf POC

Elena — perfect, thank you. Confirming next actions on our side: 

- I will upload the completed vendor packet and the signed W-9 to your portal link today. Expect an upload notification from our side by EOD PT.
- Markus, can you confirm the exact legal entity name and EIN to include on the packet? I'll fill the portal fields once I have it.
- Lauren, can you prepare the SOC2 summary and the most recent audit date in case Carlos asks? We can attach the SOC2 summary rather than the full report initially.

Marketplace note: AWS Marketplace would be an alternative procurement path that can simplify billing long-term, but it adds 2-4 weeks to onboarding. If TwinLeaf needs a fast POC kickoff, PO route is the quickest.

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Today (Thu): Redwood uploads completed packet + W-9 to TwinLeaf portal.
- Next 7-10 business days: TwinLeaf completes vendor setup and issues PO.
- After PO: Redwood schedules kickoff for POC and provides credentials/ingestion plan.

I'll attach the filled packet once Markus confirms legal details.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Dev

Attachments: completed_vendor_packet.pdf (application/pdf)

1) Legal entity name (exact): Redwood Inference, Inc.
2) EIN / Tax ID: 45-6789123
3) Remit / invoice address: Redwood Inference, Inc., 425 Market St, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94105
4) Preferred payment method: ACH (we can provide bank details in the portal form).

I attached our vendor setup instructions and the finance checklist to speed the portal upload. If the portal requires a specific CSV or banking template, please point us to it and we’ll comply.
